deltas.rationale: docs/runbooks/release.md §6, governance 0024: 0024 adds a foreign key from action_request_reconcile_checks.observation_id into observations. The previous release's observation compaction refuses to run when the catalog shows a foreign key into observations it does not check (its fail-closed guard), so after a code-only rollback scripts/apply-release.sh reports the observations-compaction step degraded until the release carrying 0024 is applied again. Nothing is deleted, and the rest of the previous release's suite passes on the new schema. HEAD's compaction knows the key, and condition (a) keeps the Observation a check settled on.

deltas.rationale: docs/runbooks/release.md §6, core 0047 row: 0047 lets a governance field of a published Operation change only together with the operation.governance_refreshed AuditRecord stating the new values, in the same transaction. The previous release's product path writes that record: its refresh_operation_governance handler writes it after refreshOperationGovernance's in-place write, in the same transaction, so a code-only rollback keeps working. These three tests call refreshOperationGovernance directly, without the handler, so the previous release writes no record and the commit is refused by design. HEAD's refreshOperationGovernance writes the record itself, and the same tests pass in HEAD; the replacements assert the record and the refusal.
